decisive_items: Shows a compound nevus with large nested melanocytes and bridging at the dermal-epidermal junction consistent with an atypical compound nevus
Score: -7.1 (where scores from -16.7 to -2.1 are consistent with a benign nevus)
Shows atypical nevus with areas of dermal fibrosis
response.rationale: Histopathology explicitly identifies an atypical compound nevus, and gene expression testing confirms a benign score, ruling out melanoma. The lesion is not congenital (appeared at age 6) and the image titles are misleading. R4 is a broader label, but R1 is the precise diagnosis supported by the first biopsy.

rejected.why: Gene expression score is in the benign range, contradicting melanoma.
Lesion developed at age 6, not congenital; histology does not support congenital melanocytic nevus.
Epidermolysis bullosa nevus is not a recognized diagnosis; image titles are likely erroneous.
Nevus of Ota is typically facial and dermal; location and dermoscopy do not match.
